notes.title: The Paupers are now available on macOS and Linux!
notes.content: Starting with patch 1.2.3 the game is now available on all major platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux!

Changes:

[/list]

notes.title: Paupers 1.2: The Crypt is out!
notes.content:
The Crypt is finally here! Decorate your personal space and visit it anytime you want!

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] items can be now selected using buttons 1-6
[*] prolonged collectibles decay timer
[*] ghosts won't attack player during ascend
[/list]

notes.title: Paupers 1.1 with Spectral Currency Exchange Office are out!
notes.content:
[b]Finally! The Spectral Currency Exchange Office is here![/b] Now you can obtain holy coins from ascending ghosts and spend them on shiny new glamorous perks. Get your SWAG now!

Collect them all to unlock the ultimate reward: [b]THE CRYPT[/b] - your own cozy place in the cemetery! [Coming in Patch 1.2]

All of this, of course, comes with an achievements refresh! And the [b]promised Pope character is here [/b]- check out his fashionable outfit!

[h3]Full changelog:[/h3]

[b]Features[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added spectral coins
[*] Added Spectral Currecny Exchange Office
[*] Added temporary invulnerability after taking damage
[*] Added skipping cinematics with LMB
[*] Added 10 unlockable perks
[*] Added two new playable characters
[*] Added 4 new achievements
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with ghost not being able to reach the circle beacuse of player blocking the way
[*] Fixed multiple misc issues with identification
[/list]

notes.title: We are a-live!
notes.content:
Step into a world between worlds, where the ethereal and the earthly collide in a whimsical yet haunting adventure. In The Paupers (formerly Dziady), players assume the enigmatic role of a spectral custodian, tasked with aiding lingering souls' transition to the afterlife. This game ventures into the surreal, guiding players through a spectral realm teeming with lost spirits.

In The Paupers, players immerse themselves in the art of spectral listening, tuning into the peculiar requests of these ghostly inhabitants. The challenge lies in fulfilling their varied and often bizarre needs, whether it's an alcoholic beverage or a long-forgotten comfort food.

The journey through The Paupers is a delicate balance of empathy, wit, and a touch of spookiness. Engaging with these lost spirits unveils layers of stories and unmet desires, each request illuminating a fragment of their past lives.

The game's unique charm lies in serving these spectral needs while exploring the intricate stories behind the spirits' presence. It's not merely about supplying items - it's about connecting with these lost souls, understanding their wishes, and ultimately guiding them toward peace in the afterlife.

But don't think it's too serious! It's a Halloween-themed spooky fun game, blending eerie encounters with delightful humor for an entertaining gaming experience.

notes.title: The Paupers will be released this Thursday!
notes.content: Prepare yourself mentally for the extraordinary role of caretaker to both spectral beings and the undead. Embrace the enigmatic responsibility of tending to spirits and those who have transcended mortality - all before the looming deadline of [b]Thursday[/b] arrives!
